Type: shelf
Name: Rivet Modern Curved Frame Floating Wall Shelf - 7.5 Inch, Gold and Natural Wood (Renewed)
This modern shelving unit is a great way to add an extra dimension to your wall decorations. The solid-fir shelf sits atop a gold-colored iron frame and 4 golden arches, which strengthen the shelf visually and structurally. 7.48"H x 25"W x 6.5"D 90% fir; 10% iron Shelf unit Avoid moisture. This item wipes clean with a soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware is included.
